lax elementwise operations

Source: R/lax.R
lax_elementwise.Rd

Ports of the elementwise functions of jax.lax. Arguments must have equal dtypes (R scalars are weakly typed and adopt the dtype of the other argument) and shapes that are equal, rank 0, or differ only in size one dimensions.

Usage

lax_neg(x)

lax_sign(x)

lax_floor(x)

lax_ceil(x)

lax_round(x, rounding_method = 0L)

lax_is_finite(x)

lax_exp(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_exp2(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_log(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_log1p(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_expm1(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_tanh(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_logistic(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_sin(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_cos(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_tan(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_asin(x)

lax_acos(x)

lax_atan(x)

lax_sinh(x)

lax_cosh(x)

lax_asinh(x)

lax_acosh(x)

lax_atanh(x)

lax_sqrt(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_rsqrt(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_cbrt(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_abs(x)

lax_lgamma(x)

lax_digamma(x)

lax_erf(x)

lax_erfc(x, accuracy = NULL)

lax_erf_inv(x)

lax_bitwise_not(x)

lax_population_count(x)

lax_clz(x)

lax_square(x)

lax_real(x)

lax_imag(x)

lax_conj(x)

lax_integer_pow(x, y)

lax_reduce_precision(x, exponent_bits, mantissa_bits)

lax_add(x, y)

lax_sub(x, y)

lax_mul(x, y)

lax_div(x, y)

lax_rem(x, y)

lax_pow(x, y)

lax_max(x, y)

lax_min(x, y)

lax_atan2(x, y)

lax_nextafter(x, y)

lax_bitwise_and(x, y)

lax_bitwise_or(x, y)

lax_bitwise_xor(x, y)

lax_shift_left(x, y)

lax_shift_right_arithmetic(x, y)

lax_shift_right_logical(x, y)

lax_complex(x, y)

lax_eq(x, y)

lax_ne(x, y)

lax_lt(x, y)

lax_le(x, y)

lax_gt(x, y)

lax_ge(x, y)

Arguments

x, y

Arrays.

rounding_method

0 (away from zero) or 1 (to nearest even).

accuracy

Optional accuracy request of the functions that take one in JAX: a lax_AccuracyMode value, "highest" or "default", or a lax_Tolerance(). It is a hint to the backend; on the CPU backend only lax_erfc() with the highest accuracy changes the computation.

exponent_bits, mantissa_bits

Target precision.

Value

An array.
